en: Dependent on a state that is neither an outflow (*anāsava*) nor a cause (*nahetu*), a state that is an outflow and a cause arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither an outflow nor a cause, a state that is an outflow and a cause arises by way of root-condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is neither an outflow nor a cause and a state that is neither an outflow nor a cause, a state that is an outflow and a cause arises by way of root-condition … one. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are five … pe … under resultant-condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are five.
Dependent on a state that is neither-outflow (no-āsava) and not-root (na-hetu), a state that is neither-outflow and not-root arises by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-outflow and not-root, a state that is neither-outflow and not-root arises by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is both neither-outflow and not-root and a state that is neither-outflow and not-root, a state that is neither-outflow and not-root [arises]… [etc.]

Arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five … pe … under result condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five. (Abbreviated.)
